meta.note: Monthly benchmark price history, Rs/kg. Seeded from public sources; the daily workflow (update_history.py) upserts the current month's point from data/public_summary.json so the series self-builds going forward.

basis_notes.Copper: LME cash settlement (westmetall.com) converted to Rs/kg using that month's USD/INR. Consistent with the live dashboard number.
basis_notes.Aluminium: NALCO ingot monthly history (via snalco.com) REBASED x0.8995 to today's NALCO basic-price basis (the source series runs ~10% high, appears duty-inclusive). Pre-Jul-2026 points are therefore rebased estimates; Jul-2026 onward is the live NALCO basic price.
basis_notes.CRGO steel: Indicative only - no free daily/historical benchmark exists. Single reference point, not a real series.

Aluminium.source: NALCO ingot (snalco.com), rebased to basic-price basis

Mild Steel.source: Indicative - HRC/MS basis, no historical feed

Stainless Steel.source: Indicative - SS304 basis, no historical feed
